samples.summary: The new local `--rebuttals` path reproduces only ONE of `parseRebuttalComment`'s normalizations, so a hand-written record missing `lens` or `file` is accepted and then silently adjudicates nothing
samples.evidence: `normalizeRebuttals` (scripts/agent/spec-to-pr.mjs, the `.map((r) => ... replace(/^agent-review-/, ""))` helper) only strips the check-run prefix and drops non-objects; `readRebuttalRecords`/`prepareRoundInputs` then write the records straight to the panel's `--rebuttals`. The cloud channel goes through scripts/agent/rebuttal.mjs:203-205, which REFUSES a record whose `lens` or `file` is empty (`if (lens === "" || file === "") return null;`) precisely because "without both, a rebuttal can never match anything". The consumers confirm it: scripts/agent/rounds.mjs:521-522 returns 0 unless `lens` AND `file` compare equal, and scripts/agent/review-panel.mjs:2328-2330 partitions with `(typeof r?.lens === "string" ? r.lens : "") === lensId`, where `lensId: lens.id` (review-panel.mjs:3018) is always non-empty. So a developer following .claude/commands/self-review.md who omits `file` (or spells the path differently from the finding's) gets a run that prints "adjudicating 1 rebuttal(s)" and adjudicates none — the silent-loss failure the docblock above `normalizeRebuttals` calls "the worst failure this path has". Fix belongs on the new code: mirror rebuttal.mjs:203-205's non-empty lens/file rejection, not only its prefix strip.
searchedFor: grep parseRebuttalComment / matchRebuttal / findingSimilarity in scripts/agent

samples.summary: A new test comment asserts behaviour `review-panel.mjs` does not have: a lens-less rebuttal is NOT adjudicated "against every lens"
samples.evidence: The `normalizeRebuttals` test comments "A record with no lens passes through: the panel adjudicates it against every lens, which is the pre-existing behaviour and not this function's call." But scripts/agent/review-panel.mjs:2328-2330 filters `rebuttals` to those whose `r.lens` equals the always-non-empty `lensId` passed at review-panel.mjs:3018, so a record with no `lens` reaches NO adjudicator — the same defect rebuttal.mjs:186-205 documents for prefixed lens names. The comment records an incorrect contract of a neighbouring module and will mislead the next reader into thinking the lens-less case is harmless.

samples.summary: Design doc still documents the removed contract: `spec-to-pr.mjs review` "needs CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN and degrades to a warn-and-skip when it is absent"
samples.evidence: docs/design/harness-engineering.md:2403-2406 — "**Local review is a convenience, not authority:** `spec-to-pr.mjs review` runs the same lenses over the working diff, but needs `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` and degrades to a warn-and-skip when it is absent." The diff deletes exactly that early return (replaced by `ambientAuthNotice`), and CLAUDE.md / CONTRIBUTING.md / .claude/commands/*.md now say the opposite (it always runs, bills the logged-in session, and is the only machine review an ordinary branch gets). docs/design/agentic-dev-loop.md:57,79 was updated; this consumer was not, and the doc lane only resolves backticked paths so nothing mechanical catches the prose.

samples.summary: `ambientAuthNotice`'s docblock misstates a neighbouring module: `createTokenPool` does not return `null` for an empty pool
samples.evidence: scripts/agent/spec-to-pr.mjs:248 claims "`createTokenPool` returns `null` for an empty pool and `buildSessionOptions` then omits the `env` override". scripts/agent/token-pool.mjs:148-168 always returns a pool object; it is `pool.current()` that yields `null` when `tokens.length === 0` (token-pool.mjs:163), read at ask.mjs:780 and then omitted at ask.mjs:523. The end behaviour the new local mode relies on does hold, so nothing breaks — only the stated contract of the other module is wrong.

verdict.reason: The local `--rebuttals` path genuinely lacks the non-empty lens/file rejection that the cloud channel enforces. `normalizeRebuttals` (spec-to-pr.mjs:632-636) only drops non-objects and strips the `agent-review-` prefix; `readRebuttalRecords` (spec-to-pr.mjs:663-673) rejects only missing/unparseable/empty files; `prepareRoundInputs` (spec-to-pr.mjs:675-689) writes the records verbatim and `panelArgs` (spec-to-pr.mjs:713) hands them to the panel. The panel's reader (review-panel.mjs:2661-2669) validates object shape only. Downstream, a record with no `lens` is filtered out of `mine` (review-panel.mjs:2328-2331, with lensId = lens.id at 3018), and a record with no `file` scores 0 in findingSimilarity (rounds.mjs:521-522) through matchRebuttal (rebuttal.mjs:315-341). The adjudication log only fires when tally.matched > 0 (review-panel.mjs:3021-3025), so nothing is printed — while the CLI already announced "adjudicating N rebuttal(s)" (spec-to-pr.mjs:1062). I grepped repo-wide for non-empty lens/file rejections and found only rebuttal.mjs:205 (PR-comment channel) and fix-report.mjs:189,564 (--fix-reports, never passed by spec-to-pr.mjs); neither is reachable from the local path. No wrapper script, schema, or workflow supplies the check. One factual slip in the write-up (.claude/commands/self-review.md does not exist in this tree) does not affect the mechanism; the CLI's own message at spec-to-pr.mjs:1116 is what directs authors to hand-write the file. In lane as a violated invariant other modules assume, with a silent skipped-work outcome at the consumer site.
